title: RayCAD document manifest
description: One snapshot of a RayCAD document (PLAN.md 3.1, 4.1), stored as canonical JSON in the objects table with kind DocState. Features are separate objects named by the BLAKE3 hash of their canonical bytes (doc.feature.schema.json). Lengths are millimetres and angles radians unless a field is an expression string with its own unit. Unknown keys are allowed everywhere and are kept when an older RayCAD rewrites the document (PLAN.md 4.4).

schema.description: Version of this object's format. A larger value means a newer RayCAD wrote it.

material.description: Workpiece material id, or null for none.

name.description: Unit and function names (mm, in, deg, rad, sqrt, sin, pi, ...) are reserved.

features.description: Feature object hashes in rebuild order.

rollback.description: The rollback bar: the id of the last feature that is built; later features are kept but not built, and new features go in after it. Absent: the whole history. Never the last feature's id.

color.description: Linear RGBA, each a float written with the shortest decimal that reads back to it.

cam.description: The CAM object: setups and operations (PLAN.md 3.6, doc.cam.schema.json). Written only when the document has CAM state.

embedded.description: The library items the document uses, each a separate object named by hash and keyed by its id (PLAN.md 3.1, doc.cam.schema.json $defs). Written together with cam.

hashes.description: Item id (a UUID) to the hash of the item's object.
